subject.title: fix(cron): preserve numeric delivery thread id across SQLite round-trip

question: Should this PR land with `job_json.delivery.threadId` as the authoritative type and value source before falling back to the split TEXT column for existing SQLite cron rows?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and covered, but it intentionally changes persisted row read precedence, and repository policy treats persisted-state compatibility as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Accept `job_json` authority
options.body: Land the PR as-is because `job_json` already stores the typed config projection and avoids parsing ambiguous numeric-looking TEXT.

options.title: Request release-row proof
options.body: Ask for one additional proof run against a copied v2026.6.11-style state database before merge.

options.title: Choose schema migration instead
options.body: Pause this PR and require an explicit typed-column or migration design if `job_json` should not be authoritative.

recommendation.title: Accept `job_json` authority
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is because `job_json` already stores the typed config projection and avoids parsing ambiguous numeric-looking TEXT.
